summary: Toast component with an imperative Toast.message(content, {duration=2000}) helper. The component animates its root div with anime.js (opacity [0,1] when visible, [1,0] when hidden, 300 ms, easing cubicBezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)) and calls afterClose (default: a no-op from the anime.js 3.2.1 alias) once the hide animation completes. message() appends a div to document.body, creates a React root (createRoot), renders the toast visible inside a setTimeout, then after `duration` ms re-renders it hidden with an afterClose that unmounts the root and removes the container. CSS classes used: styles.toast and styles.content.
